name: Fulda Cathedral: doors
_about: Fulda Cathedral (Dom St. Salvator): the great portal in the middle of the east front between its columns, oak in raised Baroque panels; the doors of the two domed chapels on the Domplatz and of the transept's ends, the same oak in single leaves

doors._about: the chapels' doors on the square (St Andrew's north, St John's south)
